name: repo-graph
display_name: repo-graph — structural codebase map for AI
description: Structural graph memory for AI coding assistants — navigate any codebase by structure, not guesswork.
long_description: repo-graph gives the assistant a structural map of your codebase — entities, relationships, and feature flows — so it navigates straight to the files that matter instead of grepping. It runs locally via uvx; nothing leaves your machine except a user-initiated git clone when you point it at a git URL.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Scan the codebase and (re)build the structural graph (incremental)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Repo overview: counts, kinds, entry points

tools.name: dense_text
tools.description: Graph in dense sigil notation (whole or seed-scoped)

tools.name: flow
tools.description: End-to-end flow for a feature, entry point to data

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Blast radius: what nodes affect or depend on (multi-seed)

tools.name: neighbours
tools.description: Direct connections to and from a node

tools.name: read
tools.description: Return a node's source, sliced from its file by line span

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find nodes by name or qualified-name pattern

tools.name: locate
tools.description: Resolve a stacktrace / failing test / diff to the most relevant nodes

tools.name: graph_view
tools.description: Visual ASCII map of a node or the overview
